pages.title: A late bus · 1/3
paragraphs: It is a cloudy Monday morning in Philadelphia. Pedro stands at a bus stop with his bag. He looks at his watch again and again. The bus is not here yet. An older woman sits on the bench with a book. He decides to ask her a question.
“Excuse me, is this the stop for the number twelve?” says Pedro. “Yes, it is. But the bus is late today.” says Ann. “How late is it?” says Pedro.
